title: [Solved] Missed signal G6 sensor
body:
**Solution**
Had to disable Huawei battery life optimisations for xDrip. From Settings -> Battery -> App Launch -> find xDrip and uncheck it.

**UPDATE**:
I noticed that when the charger is plugged in the phone, there are no problems.

Hello!
I've been using xDrip for a while with stable version (from November) on my Huawei p20 lite phone. Then I started receiving "Missed signal" error. I have tried the following things:

- Restart the phone. Used to work at the beginning, but not anymore
- Turn airplane mode on, press "Restart collector". Works sometimes, but missed signals are way too often, and I cannot get track during nights
- Switched update channel to "Alpha". Current version is from 2020.02.14. The issue is still not resolved.
Here is a screenshot with the errors:
